Loved the experience at CMX CinéBistro Stony Point! The theater was clean, the seats were super comfortable, and the service was excellent. I really enjoyed being able to order food and drinks from my seat, it made the movie night feel extra special. Definitely coming back!

Nice seats but they didn’t shut the theater door and left the lights on throughout the movie, which made watching The Conjuring a less than satisfactory experience. We were expecting jump scares, needless to say, we didn’t get them. The movie was very dark and we could barely see anything because of the bright lights. Would not recommend this theater if you’re watching a horror movie.

We have typically enjoyed CineBistro over the years, but yesterday we went to see a movie and found out once seated and with the show about to start that there was some computer or ordering issue, so there would be no food beyond gratis popcorn and soft drinks. Eh? It was so disappointing, especially considering that we do not typically go out for films and were making an event of this outing, so this was supposed to be a special treat. We appreciated that they did what they could, but we had to let this experience be known to give this caveat: If you are planning on going, you might not want to go hungry, or you might actually go hungry for the running time.

The theater is beautiful and comfortable with individual reclining chairs with cup holder. The sound was awesome. The food was delicious. We kept it simple with burgers. They have a full bar as well. Will definitely return
customer_insights: CMX CinéBistro Stony Point offers a unique movie-going experience with comfortable reclining seats and the ability to order food and drinks from your seat, making it ideal for date nights and special occasions. However, some customers have reported inconsistencies in service and technical issues that may detract from the overall experience.

venueName: Toast, New American Gastropub at The Village
address: 7007 Three Chopt Rd, Richmond, VA 23226, USA
googleReviews: What a wonderful find!! Close to University of Richmond. This bar restaurant not only had friendly service but the food was delicious. We all had burgers and they were some of the best I have had. Cooked perfectly with great sides.

I have been a long time customer and have referred friends here.   I recently got the salmon BLT salad and requested medium rare.  I am not an expert on salmon but to me, this was very rare.  I personally couldn’t eat it.   I would ask for well done if you prefer it medium.  If you want it borderline raw then go with medium rare.   I personally was very surprised to see it like this.

Very simple breakfast. The food was mediocre — we had omelettes. They only serve  hasbrowns but no regular roasted potatoes, the biscuit was dry. I wanted a latte with almond or oat milk, but they didn’t have those options. The price was very reasonable at $30 for two people. The server was very friendly, but overall, I wouldn’t come back.

Took my mom here for a birthday brunch. Once again- I'm pretty sure I ordered the tastiest item: The Salmon Reuben along with some Sweet Potato Fries.  My sister got the Veggie Benedict.  It was a bit meh.  Way too mushy. The eggs were good, but that veggie patty needed some love.  Mom got the Eggs Benefict and Dad got Meat & Potatoes dish.
Both enjoyed!  There were some other things on the menu that we wanted to try.  Will be back for another brunch adventure!

First timer here. Chatting with a friend for brunch. I decided to get the half size crab and shrimp nachos. Friend got the B&G with grits. She said it was very tasty. Mine, in the other hand, was pretty bad. Looks wise, it seemed like I was in for a treat but taste was just not good. Maybe 4 small cut pieces of shrimp and two tablespoons of very minced crab. All I could taste was the oil from the tortillas, green onions, and the Tabasco I put on for flavor. Cheese and chips melted onto the parchment paper so had to eat around it unless I wanted to eat paper. I did not want to embarrass my friend with complaining so I smiled and ate it. The menu said 8.95 but charged 9.95. Oh well. At least the service was friendly. Might try again but will stay clear of the seafood options.
customer_insights: Toast, New American Gastropub is a casual dining spot known for its friendly service and varied menu, including popular burgers and brunch items. While some dishes received mixed reviews, the overall atmosphere is welcoming, making it suitable for casual outings and brunch gatherings.

address: 11600 W Broad St, Richmond, VA 23233, USA
googleReviews: Everything and I mean Everything was delicious!!! Party of 10 we waited over a hour n half for food. Wings were burnt. Cajun voodoo chicken was dry not enough sauce. Took forever to get drinks. Never even received the beer ordered. I usually go here after work for drinks. They have Delicious food and good drinks! The bartenders are always great.

! My experience here was so amazing. Lydia was my server and she was so professional. Excellent service, food was cooked perfectly to temp. I really enjoyed the vibe. Saw the manager speaking to tables. It really made me feel like the staff cared. The food was yummy and really satisfied my hunger. It was an incredible experience. Very clean restrooms as well. customer_insights: World of Beer in Richmond offers a lively atmosphere with a focus on craft beers and casual dining. While many patrons rave about the delicious food and attentive service, some have reported inconsistent experiences, particularly during busy times. It's a great spot for groups looking to unwind after work or celebrate special occasions, but may not be ideal for intimate dinners.

address: 4901 Libbie Mill E Blvd Suite 100, Richmond, VA 23230, USA
googleReviews:
$10.00 Ready to Lunch is an awesome value in this elevated price-for-food environment. The Crispy Chicken sammich tossed in the new Asian Chili sauce is OUTSTANDING! Great value for the money!!! Check it out!

And make sure to get a good Hazy IPA to complement this delish dish!!!

Food was phenomenal!!! Went to Brunch on a Saturday. The best chicken & waffles I've ever had. The hangover burger was messy & delicious. Pizza was excellent. Moonshine espresso martini was good. Kid friendly, they have card games and board games at ready. Nice vibe overall. Wish I lived closer.

We were SO impressed with the food at Brass Tap! We got the hot honey pizza + Caesar salad, both of which were excellent. The crispy chicken and fries were delicious as well! They also have some of the best mocktails we’ve had. Super delicious and definitely underrated spot!

This must be a hidden gem in Libbie Mill, Richmond. Sure, there are more of the, but this one is SPECIAL! Our hostess today (Wednesday 30th of July 2025) was such a sweetie, the food was awsome, ND quickly served! Some very nice Crafts on tap, even happy hours!

Great place. Very well put together. Nice staff and great customer service. Place was very nice. Music was ok but could have  been better. The drinks tho lawd the drinks were on point. The bartender was doing her thing. The pizza was good as also. I would definitely come back here with no problem.
customer_insights: The Brass Tap is a casual dining venue known for its excellent food and craft beer selection. Customers rave about the brunch offerings, especially the chicken & waffles and pizzas, making it a popular spot for families and friends looking to enjoy a laid-back atmosphere.

address: 7110 Patterson Ave, Richmond, VA 23229, USA
googleReviews: First time visiting the Tavern went with a group of friends from the Red Hat Club. The food was great and the server was very attentive.  Atmosphere was good and not at all noisy!  We all had a great time meeting at our he Tavern!
Food was exceptional and the service was great. Pam was very attentive. I read from a previous review that it was a little hard to find but I used a traffic app and found it with no problem.
Great place if you can find it. Big menu. Friendly staff. Good vibes!

My husband and I stopped by The Tavern on a whim not knowing anything about the place...Oh boy did we stumble upon a local treasure. It was so quaint and spacious despite the appearance from the outside. The food was delicious, the wait staff were all very pleasant, and the restaurant itself was very cozy and clean. I will definitely be bringing my family here sometime to enjoy this hidden treasure in town. The menu ranges from the good old standards, to innovative specials, and elevated ingredients. Pricing is more than fair for the portions they serve.

Actually was looking for another place my co workers and I went to on Patterson I couldn't find it so came across this place. Anyway the place is nice, clean and the waitress was very friendly..ordered the burger it was cooked  to order and a perfect medium Temp.. the fries were hot!! I was impressed!! Left a big tip as usual for excellent service. Beautiful place will return for lunch again one day!
customer_insights: The Tavern is a cozy and friendly venue that offers a great atmosphere for gatherings, whether casual or special occasions. Patrons appreciate the attentive service and quality food, making it a local favorite for both first-time visitors and regulars.

address: 206 S Robinson St, Richmond, VA 23220, USA
googleReviews: Awesome spot. Great rotating beer options and fantastic sandwiches. They have a cozy indoor space and a large outdoor area that is smoke friendly which is an awesome plus. Highly recommend
The Cask is a very welcoming spot! They have a great selection of beers and we were surprised by the size of our sandwich. The staff was friendly and made you feel at home. Will be back!!

Very busy time, long wait at the bar. Everything is ordered through the bar, which made the line longer.  Unique concept with charcuterie style cheeses and meats. Very tasty! Beer selection is kind of limited.

I recommend this place. Outdoor seating.( That people do smoke at). Lots of indoor seating . English pub vibes. Friendly staff The prices were all very reasonable. Overall great spot.

To be fair it was my first visit so I can't speak to all the food. The grilled cheese was delicious but it was just a sandwich. They did have a limited selection of a la carte sides. The sandwich could have used some chips.
Local spot with really good craft beer. Very friendly, decent but limited menu. There is indoor and outdoor seating.
customer_insights: The Cask Cafe is a cozy and welcoming spot known for its rotating craft beer selection and hearty sandwiches. With both indoor and outdoor seating, it caters to a casual crowd, making it suitable for pregame gatherings and friendly nights out.

address: 2300 E Broad St, Richmond, VA 23223, USA
googleReviews: Came here as part of my ongoing search for the best Philly Cheesesteak in Richmond. I had been here before but never tried the food. The atmosphere is a bit weird, but definitely a different vibe that many would enjoy. The staff was solid, and they got my customization of the Philly correct. The food was really good, and the Philly ranks amongst the top I've had so far!

We had dinner with our pup on the lovely patio. Very chill atmosphere eating under the trees and umbrellas that ensure shade even on warm afternoons. Full bar and a nice beer list, good quality pub food with something for all tastes.

Service was attentive but not intrusive. Highly recommended!

Had a great visit with my pups. I'm stuck on keto, but they have an amazing gf pizza here and Ibordered supreme. They brought water bowls for the dogs and service was stellar. The ambiance was great w natural shade all over the patio. Atmosphere was great! This is a gem--can't wait to go inside when I'm not w my dogs. 5 stars!

This place is such a cool old haunt for locals! I've never tried the food there, but I always end up connecting with some of the patrons and having a great time. Definitely worth checking out! It's got a cozy bar type of feel with enough space to not feel cramped.

After a concert let out late this location was suggested to us by a different bar that had stopped serving food.
Service was nice and mood was fitting.  The food was delicious especially given the fact we wandered in after 1am.
The bar is dark.  When I was there it was mostly candlelight so it did take a moment for our eyes to adjust.

Dive bar with great food and service.
customer_insights: Patrick Henry's Pub & Grille offers a relaxed and cozy atmosphere, making it a great spot for casual dining and socializing. The venue is pet-friendly and well-received for its quality pub food, including a highly praised Philly Cheesesteak. It's a local favorite for late-night bites and a welcoming environment for both groups and individuals.

address: 6008 W Broad St, Richmond, VA 23230, USA
googleReviews: I’ve been a customer for a couple years now. I really love the amount of beer options/flights, they’re rotated frequently. Though I think very few are actually made in house. The menu is more of a Vietnamese fusion cuisine meets bar food. My favorite dishes are the shrimp banh mi (you can tell the bread is fresh) and the noodle bowls. I’ve tried other menu items but nothing noteworthy. They often have events which can be a plus for some interested or a con for those wanting to dine in showing up on one of those days by coincidence. The service can be pretty hit or miss as well, but I’ve never had an overall bad experience. They have games to play as well but I’ve never wanted to deal with the hassle of breaking bills at a busy bar.

fantastic brewery with amazing food and a cool vibe.  I forgot to take a picture of the banh mi because I ate it too fast, but high quality.  fried dumplings were crispy and savory.  wake n shrimp rice bowl hit the spot.  I'm a stout head and they did not disappoint.  took 2 visits to try it all.  they have guest taps from Perennial and Prarie, 2 of my favorite breweries, but their own stouts managed to even top those.  I had never heard of this place before this weekend but they belong on a short list of the best breweries in the US.  if this place was near my home I would be here at least weekly.
Super cool bar with an arcade in the back which was a nice touch. Tasty selection of beers as well as delicious bar food with a Vietnamese twist.

First time visiting The Answer after several years and the beer was still great, the service was good but the food was not at all what I remember. I ordered the pork dumplings and they were really under seasoned and lacking flavor. I also got the pork belly banh mi and while the pork belly was crispy, the whole thing was really under seasoned and lacking salt. Maybe it was just an off day but I was disappointed.

We got the Banh Mi shrimp sandwich and the pork fried rice bowl.  Both were tasty but the sandwich was amazing, especially the bread.  We also got two flights and were impressed by the selection and variety of different and delicious beers on the menu.  My husband especially enjoyed the German Chocolate Cake beer and the Red and Blue Triple Puffsicle, both very flavorful and unique beers!
customer_insights: The Answer Brewpub offers a vibrant atmosphere with a unique Vietnamese fusion menu and a diverse selection of beers. While the food quality can vary, the overall experience is enjoyable, especially for groups looking for a lively night out.

venueName: The British Embassy Fish and Chips
address: 1116 E Main St, Richmond, VA 23219, USA
googleReviews: Great food, attentive staff, and a cozy atmosphere. A unique combination of food as they have both Thai and traditional British fare. For those with celiac or a gluten allergy, they have gluten free fish and chips as well as sticky toffee pudding which my girlfriend confirmed were both delicious!

My wife and I certainly enjoyed our first visit to The British Embassy in downtown Richmond! We usually visit new fooderies in the afternoon just before the dinner folks arrive. The cozy restaurant was exceptionally clean and airy. Our charming server was most friendly and courteous as we ordered the cod fish and chips and of course, Guinness to compliment the meal. Our meals were served nice and hot. The fish was very tasty with a mild flavorful batter-coating and the chips were substantially light, fluffy, and mealy, with a soft, cooked potato texture and not greasy. (Unlike the standard crispy, standard-fare French fries from a fast food place.) We chose the sticky toffee pudding as dessert and what a treat! We look forward to our next visit to sample the other British-style offerings. The Thai selections on the menu are also very tempting.

Lives up to the hype! Really good fish and chips, of which I’ve had many bad ones, and yummy pad thai too. It’s not fast food, you do have a wait a little bit. Food comes out piping hot. The portions aren’t so enormous that you’ll certainly have leftovers, but plenty to make one adult feel very full. Beatles plays what appears to be 24/7, which I wonder how the staff isn’t going a bit crazy over. Prices aren’t cheap but also not overtly expensive, you’ll pay nearly $20 per entre. Worth it for a special treat but it would be difficult to be a regular spot. The desert was delicious and moist! Would give 4.5 stars if I could, mostly due to price of what are delicious but common street food dishes.

Walking by, We loved the brightness of the red, white, and blue. Inside is welcoming and cozy. The owner was the true star of the evening. He is personable , charming, funny and gracious. I had the GF cod n chips. It was outstanding! The batter tasted so buttery and crunchy it was delicious. The cod was so light and flaky, moist and flavorful!! Exactly what a proper fish n chips should taste like. The fries (chips) were okay. My guy had the bangers and mash. He said it was superb! I tasted it and really loved it! Afterwards, three of us at the table shared the Sticky Toffee Pudding. This was the very best I’ve tasted. It was not dry cake. The toffee coating was so incredibly flavorful that I wanted it all myself! Haha

This place is a true gem. They manage to serve both the best fish and chips in town AND possibly the best Thai food too. The owners are delightful and their love for their craft is readily apparent. I’ve had consistent wonderful meals in their restaurant and have recently discovered it even travels well when ordered as delivery. Highly recommend the drunken noodles, spring rolls, and the haddock and chips. But you really can’t go wrong!
customer_insights: The British Embassy Fish and Chips offers a unique blend of traditional British and Thai cuisine in a cozy atmosphere. Customers rave about the quality of the food, particularly the fish and chips and sticky toffee pudding, while the attentive service enhances the dining experience.

address: 100 S 14th St, Richmond, VA 23219, USA
googleReviews: I went for a late lunch/dinner and it was pretty empty. It was happy hour (3pm-7pm) so appetizers and certain drinks were half off. I opted for the quesabirria tacos and boneless wings. I also had 3 glasses of prosecco and paid $40 total. Overall I was pretty satisfied with the service and the food. I'll definitely visit again if I'm back in the area.

Solid dining experience, the food is really good, and the servers were great, real attentive and welcoming. I came here a couple times while in the area, and would certainly come back if I was there again!

My wife and I went for lunch w our son who's in a masters program at VCU.  It's mostly pub food, drinks were good and service was good.  A group came in from the James River and started drinking.  It became very loud, hard to talk.  My son said he doesn't go there on weekends because it's a little crazy.  Sounds like a good college bar.
Bria is amazing!!! Great customer service and attention to detail. The best bartender and I always go to her! Thank you Bria!!

Our group of 8 enjoyed lunch here today. We all absolutely Loved it! Alanna was our server and was Fabulous! She was extremely attentive to our needs even though she was also serving 7 other tables! Drinks and food were impeccable! If you haven’t been there, Go!
happy_hour_details: 3-7pm weekdays, half off appetizers and select drinks
customer_insights: Southern Railway Taphouse offers a lively atmosphere with a focus on pub food and a friendly service experience. It's a popular spot for groups and casual gatherings, especially during happy hour, making it suitable for pregaming and social nights out.

address: 1420 N Parham Rd Suite M226, Henrico, VA 23229, USA
googleReviews: I’ve heard about this place and had never been to the original location. I heard great things about this place so I was excited to check it out. We were seated promptly by the very friendly hostess in a snug little booth. The ambience was great, loud but not obnoxious. I’d say there were close to 30 tables taken, but I didn’t count.  Our server was wonderful, prompt and helpful. She checked in on us just enough times to make sure our waters were full and our food and drinks were delivered. The menu is robust and there are a lot of great options; it was hard to pick! I chose the shrimp scampi. When it was delivered, it was a soup. It was a lot of noodles, a lot of liquid, and what tasted like frozen shrimp. It was disappointing and I was just so surprised that this was what as served. The apple cobbler bread pudding made up for it. It was incredible! I would return but I would not recommend nor order the shrimp scampi.

Stopped in today for lunch and was really impressed. The service was fast, the food came out hot and fresh, and the atmosphere was comfortable and welcoming. The staff was polite and attentive without being overbearing. Overall, a great experience. I’ll definitely be coming back!

First visit to have dinner before the free entertainment show. Shrimp Tacos and Pinot Noir were delicious according to my wife.  I didn't like the mushy fish tacos.

Joined by long time friends who stopped by for drinks and the Pat O'Brien RVA show.

Highly recommend following Pat O'Brien RVA on Facebook for his schedule.

Dancing, laughing and singing were allowed.

I went here recently to grab drinks with a friend but ended up eating dinner as well. The food was absolutely AMAZING. I got the seared tuna and my friend got the sliders. I didn’t catch him for long, but he was very sweet and welcoming to us. We will definitely be back!
Great food. The tacos were great. We had fish tacos and chicken tacos. Love the claim chowder it was very flavorful.
customer_insights: Twin Hickory Tavern offers a lively atmosphere with a mix of good food and live entertainment, making it a great spot for casual dining and social gatherings. While some dishes have received mixed reviews, the overall service and ambiance are praised, making it suitable for both friends' nights out and casual date nights.

address: 4800 Forest Hill Ave, Richmond, VA 23225, USA
googleReviews: We purchased a gift certificate for a party pack of BBQ for 10 people as part of a school auction. Everything was delicious! John O’Toole was great! We definitely found a new spot! We’ll be back!

We are so lucky to have O’Toole’s as our neighborhood bar! #IYKYK…if not, stay on your side of the river, we don’t want you over here. ;) Kidding, but in all seriousness - best food, cozy, comforting & chill atmosphere, great bartenders, affordable prices. HIGHLY underrated for food quality. Have not had a single thing off the menu I didn’t like! I crave their chicken salad sandwich on the regular. Would also recommend the wings, black and bleu steak salad, pizza, potato skins, crab dip, and shoestring fries. We’ve made multiple new friends here. Thank you O’Toole’s for existing.

Classic Irish pub! I had the fish and chips, and my wife had the Shepard's pie, both were outstanding. We shared the fried pickle chips and those were also delicious.

Service was prompt and our server was friendly and helpful!

We'll be back soon!
Excellent food and service Ann Marie and Mel are great. I've been coming here since I was in high school and I've never been disappointed. BTW high school was 40 plus years ago.

This was an amazing Irish pub in Richmond. I started going there when i was a kid and their club sandwich is to die for! I had the best memories with my gradaddy there. They give a memorable experience as well as lots to look at with their perfectly decorated restaurant. DEFINITELY RECOMMEND TO PEOPLE OF ALL AGES!!!
customer_insights: O'Toole's Restaurant & Pub is a beloved neighborhood spot known for its cozy atmosphere and delicious Irish pub fare. Customers rave about the quality of food, friendly service, and the sense of community it fosters, making it a great place for casual gatherings and socializing.

venueName: Wood and Iron | Game Day Restaurant and Bar
address: 11400 W Huguenot Rd #109, Midlothian, VA 23113, USA
googleReviews:
We ordered the spinach artichoke dip, jumbo Bavarian soft pretzel, fried goat cheese and mixed berry salad with grilled chicken, and the onion straws.

The spinach artichoke dip and fried goat cheese salad were both top tier & two of the best dishes in the city imo. I really liked the pita chips that came with dip. I got the smaller salad & it was almost too much for one meal. The only thing I didn’t really like were the onion straws. They tasted too lemony or something. But overall everything was great.

Wood and Iron was a mixed experience for me. The space inside is roomy and gives off more of a standard restaurant feel with a bar. Nothing bad, just nothing memorable.

The food was okay, typical bar fare. The wings are smoked, which is a nice touch, and the burgers are decent. But overall, the menu didn’t really excite me. I didn’t love the food or drink options. The cocktails were way too liquor-forward to actually enjoy, and nothing on the menu stood out enough to make me want to come back for more.

That said, the service was great. Friendly, fast, and attentive, which I always appreciate.

If you’re looking for a chill spot with solid service and standard bar food, this might hit the mark. But personally, it wasn’t my kind of place.

This place came highly recommended so I decided to give it a whirl. Unfortunately it was probably one of the worst experiences food-wise I've ever had. Our table ordered a goat cheese flatbread and it was incredibly slimy and wet and greasy. Not a lot of flavor other than the goat cheese. I ordered the flat iron steak sandwich and it came out like there was a pile of dog food on it. I was expecting maybe some fresh cut meat and fresh vegetables because it said it had onions peppers and mushrooms but it's like it was slop all blended together nothing was fresh about that sandwich, it tasted like something out of a bucket. Also the macaroni and cheese that I got as a side was mushy and bland. I had gotten the combo plate so it came with wings and though my mush was all very hot the wings were very very cold. Severe disappointment. And something was incredibly off because I really didn't feel well for the rest of the day after eating there. It's a little noisy in there because it is a sports bar so that was expected.  Our server was great but everything else was not sadly. Tables were not being bussed in a timely manner. Some empty tables sat with dirty dishes and trash on them for at least an hour. And it wasn't even really that busy for a Saturday. Also I did notice as I was leaving that there was tons and tons of dishes left on tables that still had food on them. So I guess the question is, is the food is bad as I think it is or are just the servings too much for people to eat? Overpriced slop. Will not return.

Tried this place for the first time today. The service was better than I have ever had. Greetings when we walked in. The server was right over with water ready. The atmosphere was great, comfortable, and plenty of tvs showing all games. We ordered the pretzel, which was great and then sandwiches. I got the turkey club flight, the sauces were so good and there was so much meat on the sandwich. He got a steak and cheese flat iron, which he said he would definitely get again. I want to come back and try other options!

We happened upon this restaurant for lunch.  What a great surprise.  Generous portions, great service and food was wonderful.   Club sandwich, shrimp tacos and that wedge side salad was huge! Highly recommend.
customer_insights: Wood and Iron | Game Day Restaurant and Bar offers a lively atmosphere suitable for casual gatherings and sports viewing. While the service is consistently praised, the food quality varies significantly, with some standout dishes and others receiving criticism for being subpar.

The fries and onion crispers are very good not salty at all. Their tacos are good but very big so I wouldn’t order anything else with them. You can’t really hear your party talking without yelling because it’s too much noise in this place. The drinks are horrible, very watered down barely any alcohol in them if any honestly 🤦🏽‍♀️ Our waiter was Jordan and he was very sweet!

i've eaten here several times and each time was beyond amazing. Im only writing a review now because i tried their spinach & artichoke dip tonight. Hands down the best dip ive ever had! it is a little different than other chain restaurants, its not as liquidity/dip-like but dont let that fool you!

also: an honorable mention to the sweet potato fries. they are the bomb!

My birthday was yesterday. My guy took me to Wood and Iron. It was very busy. I love a popular place with a lively atmosphere. We ordered wings and the beautiful baked potato. I had the Honey Sriracha Wings. My guy had the dry rub wings and the potato

Ive been here a handful of times all with pleasent experiences. customer_insights: Wood & Iron Gameday Restaurant and Bar offers a lively atmosphere, making it suitable for pregame gatherings and casual nights out with friends. address: 9318 W Broad St, Richmond, VA 23294, USA
googleReviews: We were visiting from out of town and needed a place to watch the Eagles game. Glad we came here. The atmosphere was really great. A lot of Eagles fans were in attendance , and the barmaids were rocking Eagles gear too. I liked how they all worked together, for one goal, to make sure everything goes a seamless as possible for guests when it gets crowded. Felt so welcoming. I had the wings with the bone in, and fries. The flats were good and tasted fine. The drum of the chicken was a little tuff.

Our food was great! Our waitress, I think her name was Shannon, she tried her best, and did a good job in my eyes. My ex husband food got messed up x2 back to back. He was hot about that because the rest of the family were already eating. He ordered dry rub grilled and they brought out fried wings x2. 😆 My daughter was almost on the floor laughing. googleReviews:
Kindness on Tap at Rosie Connolly’s Pub

We planned our day trip to Richmond, Virginia, around ROSIE CONNOLLY’S PUB & RESTAURANT thanks to its closeness to Richmond’s Main Street Station.

After a damp day of exploring Virginia’s Capitol Building and the Canal Walk (Wed, May 28, 2025), we knew we’d be dry, warm and well fed and watered in Rosie’s at the end of our visit.

The owner’s daughter, Helen, gave us a very warm welcome and she talked to us about the history of the pub and how she’d come here from Liverpool as a child. It actually felt like we’d just walked into our local pub!

Food was on our minds, so we ordered:

🥪 Reuben sandwich & fries = $13.95
🍛 Rosie’s Chicken Balti Curry = $16.95
🍺 Guinness = $6.16
🍺 Non-alcoholic lager = $5.31
❤️ We received another round of drinks at the compliments of the owners
😢 Tax = $5.72
💰 Total = $48.09

We enjoyed our food, which was served piping hot and swiftly. The Reuben was the kind of sandwich you wished you could make as good at home! The Balti curry was interesting: a battered chicken breast was served atop the curry sauce with jasmine (coconut) rice, topped with mushrooms and onions. It had a good flavor.

A couple of pints of Guinness complemented the food nicely.

Rosie’s was busy but the owwner of the pub, Mr Thomas Goulding, waved to us and took the time to come over and introduce himself. We had a good chat and it was interesting to hear his story - the real American dream - about how he arrived here in 1985 and went on to run his own pub, having originally worked for many years at Ford back in the U.K.

When the check arrived, Helen kindly informed us that the second round of drinks was on the family. What a generous gesture and one that was indicative of the family-run business. We thinks it’s incredible that we can walk into places as strangers and find such kindness in many of the places we visit on our travels across the U.S.

Rosie Connolly’s was the type of place we could have sat in all night, enjoying the Guinness and the craic, but sadly we had a train to catch and we had to leave sooner than we would have liked. Little did we know that our train was delayed and we could have had another 30 minutes there, and as we waited in Main St. Station for our late train, we looked out down onto the rear of Rosie Connolly’s thinking about our memorable visit. If only we could pop back; we know we’d be welcome!

Good beer, but needs cleaning. Open kitchen looks like a pots and pans dish washing staging area. Food sounded good on menu, but seeing the condition of the place changed our minds. Oh, and $2.50 for a few oz cup of cheese for the $6 pretzel is outrageous.

Been coming here for a while. The beer is superb, the staff is professional and hospitable. The food is impeccable. Any day of the week is a good day to go to Legends. Definitely a staple of the city of Richmond

Found out this place does $1 wing nights on Wednesday’s and we’ve been coming every week since! What a deal!!! The wings and their drink, ‘the richmonder’ are delicious! Service has been great every single time we’ve come and the views of the city from the outdoor patio are stunning 😍

Great Brewery!  Wonderful outdoor patio that kind of overlooks The James.  Also, one of the few places that you can also get some taste of some Deutch food.  Live music, trivia, and movie night.  Plus, all their own and other beer selections.  Service is very good and so is the food.  Getting to it, you might think it's in a skecty area, but not the case. Well worth your time to check it out!
customer_insights: Legend Brewing Co is a popular brewery in Richmond known for its vibrant atmosphere and stunning outdoor patio views. While the food and service can be hit or miss, the brewery offers great deals like $1 wing nights and hosts various events, making it a lively spot for groups and casual gatherings.

address: 5203 Hatcher St, Richmond, VA 23231, USA
googleReviews: Pizza was very cheesy but still very good, customer service was great, wine was wining. Definitely would return with a group of friends and indulge in their big facility. 8/10 🎀

What an amazing brewery. The pizza was phenomenal and the beer was as good as I'd been told it'd be. The dark Czech was a standout for me and I appreciate the employee who walked me through all the different IPAs and let me sample a few for free before making a decision.

In nicer weather the exterior seating looks like it'd be lovely too. Everything was clean and despite being busy it wasn't too loud. Ample parking on site as well.

My only gripe was the limited to-go options. They had so many beers I really liked but only 5 to go when I visited.

Definitely worth checking out if you're in town and also on my list of places to return to!

My husband, Justin, and I rented Triple Crossing for our wedding reception last November, and it was nothing short of incredible! We were looking for an industrial space that we could transform into our own with a Wes Anderson-inspired tropical vision, and it absolutely delivered. Chelsea and Dani were amazing to work with, and their on-site team was so accommodating on our big day. The space was the perfect size for our 100-person guest count, and we had an absolute blast with a pizza buffet, live band, photo booth, and temporary tattoo bar. Our friends and family are still raving about the appetizers, wood-fired pizzas, and—of course—the Falcon Smash!

Fantastic spot! Great venue, solid beer, amazing people, epic pizza.

Seriously the honey hit pepperoni is the best pizza I have ever had. 🙌
Fulton is a regular for us after our rides on the Capital Trail, so we decided to spend Valentines there as well! Excellent pizza as always and the Valentines menu was a great addition
customer_insights: Triple Crossing Beer - Fulton is a vibrant brewery known for its delicious wood-fired pizzas and a wide selection of craft beers. The venue offers a great atmosphere for groups and is suitable for various occasions, from casual hangouts to special celebrations.

venueName: The Veil Brewing Co. - Scott’s Addition
address: 1509B Belleville St, Richmond, VA 23230, USA
googleReviews: Veil’s new location is great, stays on brand with the same feel as the Forest Hill location. Remedy burger is a winning combination to Veil’s masterful collaborations with local food options. This new upgrade will definitely have craft beer fans coming back for more.

Cut your losses and get a mcdouble with fries, really abysmal food quality. Stick to the beer. The "Oklahoma onion" burger shows what scraps of onions were on it. Oh, and there were a handful of stale fries included in the $13 combo... Come on people

What a great spot! Had a delicious Remedy burger with fresh toppings with the right amount of smash burger crisp, along with  healthy serving of truffle fries - a fantastic meal all around! Also great beers with a huge selection and a couple cocktails available as well! The spot is huge on the inside and has ample outdoor seating also. A great afternoon spent here and will definitely be stopping by again next time I’m in Richmond! Go and enjoy yourself!

So good that I came back twice in one weekend (to show friends). The bartender was great and super helpful in picking out beers and even remembered me the next day. Every beer I had was great and the menu was just so expansive.

Also the restaurant on site deserves a shout-out for coming in clutch. A meal I ordered was meant to be vegetarian and when I noticed bacon in it they immediately remade it without question.

Abundant seating and a huge selection of beer to go. Plenty of street parking in the neighborhood. My only issue was the bathroom set-up; it's a series of single use stalls with their own doors but they can be very cramped and the entire space is a bit messy and also poorly lit.

So this brewery has been on my wish for so long but it was a decent trek from Philly. We happened to be in Virginia for family and we popped down (though as predicted the traffic was HORRENDOUS in both directions so plan accordingly).
The brewery is gigantic, lots of indoor and outdoor seating, in house food which was amazing. Flavorful, balanced and just chef's kiss to complement the delicious beers.
Ok the beer -- that's the main event. We decided to try most of the beers that were on draft (they also do can pours), the IPAs are outstanding, obviously it's what they are known for, but I was so so happy to also have great ales, the Saison and Belgian beers were so good. Staff were so nice and welcoming and we got great swag and cans to go as well before leaving.

Outside is VERY dog friendly (they'll give you a clean water bowl and fill it) and SHADED which for any pale folks 🦇👻 *most of the outdoor area is in shade for the entire day which was much appreciated for me and our two double coated pups.

Ample free street parking, affordable food and drinks just an overall solid place to check out.
If I didn't live hundreds of miles away I would visit this place on the regular
customer_insights: The Veil Brewing Co. in Scott's Addition is a vibrant brewery known for its extensive beer selection and casual atmosphere. While the food quality has received mixed reviews, the overall experience is enhanced by the spacious indoor and outdoor seating, making it a great spot for social gatherings and pregame activities.

address: 12830 W Creek Pkwy Unit J, Richmond, VA 23238, USA
googleReviews: An amazing place that is so personable and friendly!  If you are in the west side of Richmond, this brewery is absolutely worth a stop. The beers were great! They were having a big concert event, so they typically don't do flights, but when we explained we were from Texas, they were gracious enough to pour us some. Loved their Mexican Lager and their flagship IPA, Headspace. Definitely check them out!

Everyone who works for this establishment must truly love what they do.  The team is knowledgeable,  friendly, and go beyond expectations to provide a great experience.   And the beer is outstanding as well.

Don't know what I expected being located In a business park, but it exceeded all expectations. Service was fast and friendly with great recommendations, the the atmosphere was cozy and welcoming. Love that they take a lighthearted approach to their beer. Oh, and I found their beer to be quite good with enough assortment for most people. COVID safety, they put a sign on the table stating it has been cleaned, great idea! They have two good size decks if you are interested in sitting outside. Fun place, make sure and check it out.
Update: they changed policy where dogs are now allowed inside the building not just outside on the deck!
Great venue space and awesome live music. Loved the Mexican chocolate stout!
Great atmosphere and food! Ordered the chicken, it was life changing. The live music was nice too. The employees were so sweet, will definitely be back soon!
customer_insights: Kindred Spirit Brewing is a friendly and welcoming brewery located in a business park in Richmond. Patrons rave about the knowledgeable staff, great beer selection, and cozy atmosphere, making it a perfect spot for casual gatherings and live music events.

venueName: The Veil Brewing Co. - Forest Hill
address: 4910 Forest Hill Ave, Richmond, VA 23225, USA
googleReviews: Stopped by for a cold one on a hot day. Big, open space inside,  perfect for groups. Nice selection of beers. Lots of outdoor seating, but to hot for us. Since we had the doggo with us, we opted for a to-go order and took home some fresh cans. Loved the Tastee sour!

Great beer, sleek modern interior, kid friendly, and decent food. When we ordered from site on toast order was done but sat around.. recommend ordering at cashier. Food was decent- nothing to rave about but good execution. Salsas were yummy would want more quantity. Quesadillas and tacos were good. Beer and service was great. Parking is available but full - has to circle around a few times.

This place is great, hands down, and usually that would be a 5 star but my second beer that was an ipa instead of a lager tasted burnt, something is off. This flavor I have tasted at bingo as well. Not great. So 4 stars. y tu mama was great and staff is great.

Located along Forest Hill Avenue in a nice suburb of Richmond, the structure has an industrial vibe with metal and polished concrete and sharp angles. There is a popular Mexican restaurant, Y Tu Mama, located within. On a beautiful Saturday afternoon there was plenty of foot traffic outside with activity in the neighboring businesses.

The environment was pleasant and the service was super friendly. I’ve been a fan of the New England IPAs this summer and I tried the Lil’ Supernatural Freak hazy NEIPA and it was delicious.

The indoor seating is limited and the place was fairly full. There is no bar, just an ordering counter, and there are no televisions or blaring music. There is seating upstairs, but it was closed off for a special event. I found a comfortable spot outside to enjoy my beer.

One of my favorite breweries in Richmond! Amazing beer with TONS of options. The restaurant inside is equally amazing. I was a little concerned with how fast my food came out but one bite and I knew I was hooked. Highly recommended
customer_insights: The Veil Brewing Co. - Forest Hill offers a casual and friendly atmosphere with a great selection of beers and decent food options, making it suitable for groups and casual outings. The venue is pet-friendly and has ample outdoor seating, although it can get busy, especially on weekends.

address: 434 Hull Street Rd, Richmond, VA 23224, USA
googleReviews: Fabulous taproom. Nice workers and cool atmosphere, makes for a really cool hangout stop. If I lived near it I would be a regular. Also, the beer is fantastic.

Beautiful taproom, clean and modern. Most importantly the brews are excellent. Kevin is in full control behind the bar, knows his beer A-Z and has a great knowledge of the area as well.

"Treat yo' self" and eat one of the best dang hot dogs you'll likely ever find. I can't remember the last one I had because I'm not really a fan, the one I ate here was fantastic!

Oh sorry this is all that is left of the amazing fire stone cooked Pizza I enjoyed tonight! Perfect place to wind down, caught some poetry and the beer selection is the best on this side of town!!! Will be back again next Wednesday! I hope we have more Pizza like this in the future !

Me and my family came here recently for a bingo night and it was so much fun ! We enjoyed playing, jamming out to some Beyoncé 😜, and the food was delicious we got the dirty hot dog with chilli & shredded cheese, and nachos. I definitely recommend this fun activity for everyone you will love it! Thank you Benchtop Brewing & Mrs. Maggie! 🦄⚡️💚🤩👏🏾
Great beer, and good food. Nice small tap room. Make sure you look for all of the small roosters around. I saw about 20 while I was there.
customer_insights: Benchtop Brewing is a vibrant taproom known for its fantastic beer selection and a fun, casual atmosphere. The venue hosts engaging events like bingo nights and live music, making it a great spot for social gatherings with friends or family.

address: 3110 W Leigh St, Richmond, VA 23230, USA
googleReviews:
We quickly popped in here 10 minutes before closing to pick up a growler of beer, and we were so pleasantly surprised having never been here before. The bartender was nice and helpful, and he gave us great options.

Their pumpkin seasonal is a really good dark (but not heavy) ale, full of pumpkin flavor.  They had a Granny Cider that wasn't overly sweet. And, an Triple IPA that didn't smack you in the face with IPA (but also super strong). Be sure to get your best sipping glass for it!

If you're a fan of more sweet hard ciders and/or sour ales, stop into Strangeways Brewing. They sell all kinds of beer and the menu is organized by flavor. I ordered a flight of all the tart beers and found them unique. The Lucky Charms one is unique and tastes like the cereal. The cider is excellent and I loved the Razzle sour ale. So refreshing!

The space is one big room with plenty of tables and a corner of games. Most of the games are broken and come with missing pieces.

The service was efficient and friendly enough. Staff didn't seem thrilled to have three kids at the brewery, but alas.

I'm new to Richmond and stopped by while walking my dogs. Plenty of shaded seating on the side outdoors and the friendliest of people...I had someone offer to carry out a bowl of water for my dogs while I had 2 leashes and a beer in tow. Inside was cool and caters to military, teachers, locals--you name it. If the light beer I got (I'm on Keto for 60 days so a light beer already blows half my daily carbs) is any indication, I'm excited to return Memorial Day off my diet to explore all the sours, IPAs, and darker things I enjoy. I had the best light beer here I've ever had, though I rarely order light. 5 stars for sure!

Enjoyable brewery! Staff were friendly and attentive, and it gave off similar vibes to the OG production facility location a short drive away. Beer is enjoyable with plenty of sizes and options to choose from. The blues band playing elevated the experience. Great place to hit when trying to knock out all the Scott’s Addition breweries.

I visited around 1:30 during an "adult book fair" that ran from 12-4. The book fair was FANTASTIC, featuring local authors and other books my wife loved. It didn't pack the taproom, and there was plenty of seating.
The rest of the experience, however, was unfortunately poor. I waited in a 15+ minute line for beer while a single bartender struggled to provide good interaction and serve beer and food to each person. He disappeared multiple times to prep food and deliver it, but clearly had no other choice. Another bartender appeared halfway through the wait, but spent his time catching up on dishes and doing... something? else, despite the massive line.
The beer was fine, but I wasn't about to wait in that line for another, so this was a one-and-done. MANAGEMENT, if you're gonna schedule an event, be sure to schedule staff to go with it. Your people tried their best, but you set them up for failure.
customer_insights: Strangeways Brewing RVA-Scott's Addition is a casual brewery known for its friendly atmosphere and diverse beer selection, including unique sours and ciders. The venue is pet-friendly and features outdoor seating, making it a great spot for groups or casual hangouts, though service can be inconsistent during busy events.

venueName: Basic City Beer Co. Southside RVA
address: 212 W 6th St, Richmond, VA 23224, USA
googleReviews: Really cool joint. Great atmosphere, seems like it was an old industrial building back in the day. Beautiful exposed brick and machinery from back in this buildings hay day. Beer was wonderful, American IPA that is not overly hopped but still has some good bitterness to it. Parking seems like it might be tough if it gets busy but was perfectly fine when was there.
Great beer, easy access. Why sitting at home when you could be here?!

My favorite brewery in Richmond, hands down.
Curtis and Sara are incredible owners who create a welcoming atmosphere — the kind of place where you walk in and instantly feel like you're among friends.

They offer an impressive variety of beers: IPAs, DIPAs, sessions, lagers, and imperials. My go-to is the 6th Lord — a perfect daily drinker.

The space is huge, making it ideal for group hangouts or just a chill night with a couple of friends. It’s also kid-, dog-, and bike-friendly, with a game room tucked in the back to keep everyone entertained.

And if you're hungry? Their pizzas are legit.

Highly recommend. See you there!

Been a year of coming in. People are always good. Beer is always fresh. Things are straightforward and you can meet friends just by being you. The speciality beers that rotate are better than you’d imagine. I’d say go towards medium to fuller body brews and keep your dog ready for treats.

I really enjoy the food and FOH staff, and probably everyone and everything there minus the head pizza guy. This review is solely because of him because I go here every so often for events, trivia, and just to hang out with friends. I dont understand his problem with me but he continues to go out of his way to be a completely and utterly rude, aggressive, drunk old man. If I try to bus my own pizza tray, he rips it out of my hands. Ive helped a dnd event where he kept asking me why I was there and how we didnt need 3 people to host the event...? Im sorry im contributing to the establishment by buying pizza. I feel very uncomfortable when he is around, he is always staring so aggressively. Drinks on the job constantly so maybe thats why? Very miserable old man  whatever the case. I really hate going to Basic City because of this specific individual so no more!
customer_insights: Basic City Beer Co. Southside RVA is a casual brewery with a welcoming atmosphere, perfect for group hangouts and dog-friendly outings. While the beer selection is highly praised, the venue has occasional service issues, particularly with one staff member, which may affect the overall experience.

address: 3331 W Moore St, Richmond, VA 23230, USA
googleReviews: Absolutely visiting Väsen. The Hefeweizen is incredible. One of my favorite breweries in RVA. If you like the brews grab yourself a 4 pack to go.
I’ve been wanting to come to this brewery for a few years now and it definitely lives up to expectations. Friendly staff, delicious beer, and lovely decor. Will definitely be back!!

Such a great spot for a good brew.
The beers were delicious,  the staff were lovely, of all the breweries I went to in Scott's Addition (which is a few) this was my favourite. Some really tasty sours, ipas and unexpectedly the golden stout was also good. Thanks for a lovely evening

I love that they had several sours on tap! They were good. I had the passion fruit and wasn’t disappointed. Husband had a flight and the board that holds the cups are so unique. You can tell a lot of detail and passion went into them.  I love the boulder in the middle of the bar you can sit at. Outdoor seating is awesome! Dogs welcome on the patio so you get to see cute pups while you drink beer. How can you go wrong? Staff was knowledgeable and friendly!

Stopped here after making our way through Scott’s addition area. Great outdoor benches and a smaller capable inside for seating. The staff were super friendly and the brews were honestly some of the best in the area if not thee best. Group favorites include the Radapils, Golden Stout, the Velvet Walrus. Happy to check this place out again and again. Cheers!!!
customer_insights: Väsen Brewing Company in Scott's Addition is a beloved brewery known for its friendly staff and a diverse selection of delicious beers, including sours and IPAs. The welcoming atmosphere, outdoor seating, and dog-friendly patio make it a great spot for casual gatherings, whether with friends or for a laid-back date.

address: 3200 W Leigh St, Richmond, VA 23230, USA
googleReviews: Great location, beer garden is great. Beer is quality and continues to improve. Love their IPA series. (That was before) I now work in the neighborhood and Ardent is my go to spot. The X is a quality and consistent member of my IPA beer diet and I enjoy trying their rotating seasonals across the board. The adjacency to Eazzy Burger and ZZQ are solid adds to the site and it is absolutely the best beer garden in Richmond. Also the staff is amazing.

Tasty beers and more! Plenty of room inside and out. As a dark beer fan, I appreciated the availability of a Porter and a Stout in June, both of which were excellent. The lighter beers were great for a summer evening as well. No complaints! Convenient option to order from your table, and food arrived almost immediately. A great choice whether you're looking for a flight of flavorful craft beers or just a tidy place to hang out. Cheers!

Good variety of brews available here. They had a lot of IPA's available, if that's your thing. There was a nice selection of food options on the menu. The place has a good atmosphere with seating, available inside and out. I will definitely be back.

Such a lovely little brewery. The staff was ace. Lively people with a. Great knowledge of their beers. Were happy to let you sample before choosing a beer to go with for the night. The pop and the 14 were great choices, and Maddie was great behind the bar.
Would definitely recommend and revisit I'd im in the area again.
Great beers, friendly staff, and an excellent atmosphere. Recommend checking it out if you haven’t yet.
customer_insights: Ardent Craft Ales is a beloved brewery in Richmond known for its quality craft beers, particularly its IPA series. The venue features a spacious beer garden, friendly staff, and a vibrant atmosphere, making it a great spot for casual hangouts, pregame gatherings, or a laid-back night out with friends.

address: 5 S 20th St, Richmond, VA 23223, USA
googleReviews: Found this gem while looking for a brewery that was open early on a Sunday, and had food. Mostly indoor seating, but it's a lovely space looking into the brewery. Staff was excellent in explaining the brewery history, the beers and the food. We ordered all the apps and enjoyed them all. Then we got a little creative and ordered the chicken strips to tear up and put on their mushroom pizza, as they don't offer additional proteins or toppings. Both were excellent. Only downfall was parking, but we did see something down the alley that may have been for the brewery.

This is a really good brewery. Their selection is slightly limited, but the quality is not. Their “German” style beers are wonderful. They have lPA’s and sours as well. They’re just not my cup of tea 😉

My daughter and I had some time to waste prior to an appointment and we stumbled upon Richbrau Brewing and I am so glad we did!  I had the Richbrau Lager and Psychic Horse; both were really good and hit the spot. We didn't grab a bite to eat as we had dinner reservations elsewhere, but from the look and smells of those around us who were eating, I definitely want to come back and try some pizza!

The atmosphere is relaxing and laid back. They have a patio area where you can sit and enjoy a cold one or inside their spacious interior. There is a small selection of board games to play and sports on the tv. Not too loud, friendly staff and great beer - who could ask for anything more!
Love this place.  The beer is both creative and brewed to perfection.  The staff is always friendly and helpful.  Plenty of games and nice vibe inside.  Really can’t recommend enough.

The beer is excellent.
The staff is warm and kind.
The décor is rustically charming.
In a world with too many beers that are hop-monsters or ABV queens, Richbrau's beer offerings are stunningly balanced. Whether their style of beer is to your liking or not (it is definitely to mine), you will respect the products. They make interesting beer. If I lived in closer than 100 miles, this would be a regular joint for me.

The DDH Dapper Thief DIPA is on my short list of most interesting beers I have had all year.
customer_insights: Richbrau Brewing offers a relaxed atmosphere with a focus on quality craft beers and a limited but well-executed food menu, including pizza and appetizers. The friendly staff and inviting space make it a great spot for casual gatherings, pregame meetups, or simply enjoying a laid-back afternoon with friends.

address: 6118 Lakeside Ave, Richmond, VA 23228, USA
googleReviews: Great “Pop Up” for dinner by River City Wood Fire!  Our dinner, beer and outside patio were the perfect end to our busy day!♥️🍺 We will be back!

Absolute best beers in all of RVA, heck maybe the best in the world! For sure the friendliest staff of any RVA brewery, and hands down the most welcoming environment! Stop in, bring your pup, and enjoy a phenomenal brew! ~Cheers

This is the best brewery in RVA in my opinion. Everything is really good to top notch. They had 8 different IPAs on top last time I visited. It has a great local vibe too with an awesome mojo. Outside food is welcome and there’s a BBQ place within walking distance if you don’t plan ahead. Come check it out and experience the best Richmond has to offer.

This place was awesome! Great location in a smaller and more intimate area. All of their beers are gluten reduced. ALL OF THEM! This was a small version of heaven for me. They were all friendly and had some nice game horns to play, including darts and arcade games. They appear to be very organized and clean, which I was impressed with.  They have a nice outdoor patio area, but also allow well behaved dogs inside. This was a surprise to us, but a very nice one. Overall, I wish we had more time here to go back because their beers were delicious, gluten reduced or not. This is definitely a must for anyone in the area who likes beer.

Stopped here to break up a long drive home. Nicely situated near some antique shops, so good excuse to stretch the legs. Ordered the Astro Hazy IPA, which is quite refreshing.

Nice atmosphere, lots of tables inside and out, and a cool Pinball/Arcade setup make this a place I could return to. Service was also fast and friendly!
customer_insights: Final Gravity Brewing Co. is highly praised for its friendly atmosphere and top-notch beer selection, particularly their gluten-reduced options. The venue is dog-friendly, has a nice outdoor patio, and offers a casual vibe perfect for groups or a laid-back evening out.

address: 4300 Williamsburg Ave, Richmond, VA 23231, USA
googleReviews: Very cool location, and a beautiful building. The beer is fantastic and the staff were wonderful and very helpful with the selection of beers.

Been here a few times for various occasions and it’s a great spot! Great selection of beverage options, especially for people who may not drink beer but are out with people who do. Stone also hosts little vendor fairs and such, which are nice to check out. Thank you to all of the amazing staff who keep this beautiful brewery clean and hospitable all the time! Your hard work and care for your craft truly shows.

Stone was very kind and accommodating when my boat party got canceled due to rain! We were able to quickly pivot and squeeze in. We made the mistake of bringing outside food but they didn’t make us feel bad about it. I’m excited to come back to trivia and I’m glad I got to introduce 13 new folks to this spot.

Customer service is great. Accommodating, helpful and explain things in detail. Clean inside and out. I appreciate that they offer wireless internet since it seems to be located in a dead zone and service can be spotty regardless of service provider. Plenty of parking options. It's a walk to the parking lot and some areas are not lit enough. It's a 4 out of 5 for me.

What I love about this space is you are so close to the city but feel so far. It's proximity to an undeveloped wooded area, a train track, and the river feel like a reprieve from the busyness of life (though the train can be loud.)  They've got a great selection, indoor and outdoor seating, and a food truck.
customer_insights: Stone Brewing Tap Room in Richmond is a vibrant and welcoming venue known for its fantastic beer selection and accommodating staff. The brewery offers a unique atmosphere that feels both close to the city and a retreat from its busyness, making it suitable for various social occasions, including trivia nights and casual gatherings.

address: 1603 Ownby Ln, Richmond, VA 23220, USA
googleReviews:
Cool location that offers live music. Plenty of space with an older building that provides character.

Beer was average but I am super picky about beer having been traveling the craft beer scene for two decades.
Thumb Stick event at Main Line Brewery. Great beer as always.  A little drive out of the way but well worth it.

I watched the people standing on the corner of Leigh and Hermitage directing the Give a Dog a job thing throw a broken Hennessy bottle into the bushes and left it. Why is iit ok for y'all to put the pets of the people that live here at risk while your people interrupted an entire community due to posting no notifications.

Great location with plenty of outdoor and indoor space to enjoy. There is a great selection of beer and a separate section that mixes some great vodka drinks. Live music is popular here and there is always a good crowd of people. Dog friendly and a good choice for a weekend outing or happy hour.

Love this space, we have our jeep events here with River City Wranglerz and it is a great time every time. Always has live music on Sundays.
Good drinks, good prices and good people. They have a rum bar, vodka area and beer area. There is also an inside and outside stage for events and bands and LOTS of space to enjoy. Dog friendly!!
customer_insights: Main Line Brewery is a vibrant venue known for its live music and spacious layout, making it a great spot for social gatherings. While the beer selection received mixed reviews, the atmosphere is lively and dog-friendly, appealing to a diverse crowd looking for a casual night out.

address: 1800A Summit Ave, Richmond, VA 23230, USA
googleReviews: A must stop if in Richmond.  Definitely doing a lot right with their whiskeys and looking forward to sipping some longer age statements as they progress.  Tasting room is very good and staff is knowledgeable and enthusiastic. While I only had a short time to spend there; it was well worth the stop.  Well above average whiskeys with Richmond character.   Next trip is going to be a HazMat visit and some Ubers 😁

Great whiskey. Very pricey. Didn't buy.
I didn't appreciate that there are so many tastings available for bottles that aren't available for purchase.
I felt like the mediocre stuff was for sale. The good stuff was only available for expensive tastings.
Some tastings are $19 for a half ounce.
Staff was attentive and friendly.

Cocktails were good, and their alcohol on its own was good too!
The place is super cute and I love the atmosphere so much!!! I definitely recommend any of their cocktails, and the pure rye drink was delicious!

But unfortunately whoever was working there on 9/8/25 at 6pm was a little rude. We asked about their other alcohol and she just said "lots of different things, we do that for a reason" and then stopped talking. We were going to purchase something but that kinda put us off since we didn’t get to learn about it. I would understand if she had a bad day or was shy, but she was so much more talkative to the people who came in after us. I promise we weren't rude, we were just tired from being in a car for 72 hours. We tried to make conversation and she ignored us but talked to the next people a lot :( I’m unsure what we did, but it definitely soured the whole experience.

10/20/24 Stopped in for a tasting while visiting from Charlotte. 100% Wheat, Corn and Rye  flight.  Hunter and Scott bourbon and Whiskey. Dara was super friendly, smart, beautiful and so so informative and the tasting was exactly what I needed.  Came back a year later 6/20/25 , no Dara,  customer service was more utilitarian than special. Bourbon good, cocktails good but not inspired to bottle a bottle. I always say it’s the experience that makes you want to buy.  Our experience the second time was lack luster. Spent $50 plus for a simple flight and two drinks.  May not be back. Too many “great experience” places to try.
kurt was amazing! very personable, good conversation. came here for a birthday and im not a bourbon drinker but he suggested something i really liked. i would definitely come back
customer_insights: Reservoir Distillery is a trendy spot in Richmond known for its high-quality whiskeys and cocktails. While the atmosphere is generally enjoyable, customer service experiences can vary, with some patrons noting a lack of engagement from staff. It's a suitable venue for pregame gatherings or casual nights out, but may not be ideal for special occasions.

address: 1727 Rhoadmiller St, Richmond, VA 23220, USA
googleReviews:
Do you wish to be noticeably unnoticed? Receive awesome customer service, great live music within an atmosphere that's just great?
This is your place! The staff are easy going, genuine people the establishment is timeless!

For us elite NA's out there , they have something for us too ! Which everything NA option is awesome!
